steps.path: Right after you press Run it on an admin command
steps.headline: The line under the password box is gone; Confirm sits directly under the field.
steps.changed: Your R2-3 note: 'Used once for this step, then erased…' is removed. The promise still holds, it just isn't printed.
steps.notice: A shorter card: heading, command, password box, Confirm.

steps.path: An admin command that keeps running after it starts (a server, for example)
steps.headline: A command still running with admin rights shows a 'Running as admin' strip with a Stop button, visible even when the card is folded.
steps.changed: You said yes to this on the questions deck. The strip shows how long it has run and stays until the command ends or you press Stop.
steps.notice: You can always see when something still has full control of your computer, and stop it in one click.
steps.risk: A program that has fully split off from its command can outlive Stop; the app may then need your password again to end it.

highlight.text: Still has full control of your computer until it ends.
